name: Seijaku no Kaze
source:
Silence and darkness dominated there... I wanted to break this silence, so I opened my mouth wide. The cold night air made my mouth shiver. Even so, in the seemingly endless night, I shouted out loud by myself...

The town the protagonist had stumbled upon was an odd space with neither people nor electricity. In such an extreme and unusual situation, the protagonist would end up living with a few survivors. As they pondered the mystery of the disappearing phenomenon and took actions with the survivors, a slight discomfort was felt in this world.

The survivors' distrustful actions and the mysterious deaths. When the truth is uncovered, the gears start to go awry...

[from DLsite]
translation:
那里只剩寂静与黑暗……我想打破这片寂静，于是张大了嘴。寒冷的夜风吹得嘴唇发颤。即便如此，在这仿佛没有尽头的夜里，我仍独自放声呼喊……

主人公偶然闯入的小镇，是一个既没有人影、也没有电力的诡异空间。在这种极端而异常的处境下，主人公开始与少数幸存者一起生活。一边思索人口消失现象背后的谜团，一边与幸存者们展开行动，主人公渐渐察觉到这个世界里一丝微妙的违和感。

幸存者们可疑的举动，以及接连发生的神秘死亡。当真相揭晓，命运的齿轮也开始错位……
